post.description:
Verify credentials, set the session cookie, and return the public user.

An unknown email and a wrong password return the same 401 body, so the endpoint cannot be used
to enumerate accounts.

Clear the session cookie.

Logout is idempotent: it succeeds even when the caller has no valid session, so a browser can
always discard a stale or tampered cookie.

Create an account from a valid invite, set the session cookie, and return the public user.

A member invite also creates its league membership in the same transaction, so the response
includes that league; an admin invite returns ``league: null`` and the account must complete
onboarding. Unknown and expired invite codes share one 400 response so the endpoint does not
help a caller distinguish which part failed. A taken email returns 409.
Add a league as an admin; members join only by redeeming a member invite.

delete.description: Delete this league and all of its data, leaving accounts and other leagues intact.

get.description:
Return a league's saved Elo settings, or the defaults, for an admin member.

A non-member gets 404 (the league is not confirmed to exist) and a member without the admin
role gets 403.

post.description:
Generate one invite from the admin page and return its raw code exactly once.

A member invite is bound to this league; an admin invite is league-less. Only the code hash is
stored, so no other endpoint can return the code again. Defaults to a seven-day expiry.

get.description:
List the accounts associated with a league for an admin member.

A non-member gets 404 (the league is not confirmed to exist) and a member without the admin
role gets 403. Emails are the account identifier; passwords, credentials, and hashes are never
part of the response.

delete.description:
Remove one user's membership in this league, subject to the last-admin guard.

The account and its other memberships are untouched. Removing the last admin member returns a
structured 409; a user without a membership in this league returns 404.

get.description: Return the owners a member may associate with their own membership.

post.description: Refresh a league using the caller's stored credentials, subject to rate limits.

get.description: Return the seasons stored for a league the caller belongs to.

post.description:
Add and sync one more season for an existing league.

Only a global admin who belongs to the league may call this. The season sync uses the caller's
own stored credentials, and the whole write is atomic: a provider failure returns a structured
error and leaves no partial season behind. Credential values never appear in the response.

get.description:
Return every stored season's admin settings for an admin member.

A non-member gets 404 (the league is not confirmed to exist) and a member without the admin
role gets 403. The cup week, regular-season week range, and last successful provider sync are
read from stored rows; no provider is contacted.

delete.description:
Delete one stored season's data, keeping the league, accounts, and other seasons.

Scores, matchups, teams, and the season row go in one transaction; owners, memberships,
invites, the league, and every other season remain. An unknown or unreadable season returns a
structured 404.

get.description: Return a stored season's cup week and the regular-season week range it may use.

put.description: Set or clear a season's cup week and recompute its stored VP in the same transaction.

get.description:
Return per-team playoff, bye, and division-title probabilities for a league season.

Only the league's latest stored season is simulated. An older stored season returns a
structured 409 ``season_not_current`` without reading simulation inputs or touching the cache;
an unknown league or unstored season keeps the standings-style 404. ``strength_weight`` scales
team strength in future weeks only; it never changes stored data, the provider, or current
totals.

parameters.description: Team-strength weight: 0 makes every remaining matchup even, 1 is the default model, and up to 10 amplifies stronger teams. Decimals are accepted, with at most 18 decimal places.

post.description:
Refresh one stored season through the provider with the caller's stored credentials.

The season must already exist, so a refresh never creates or duplicates a season. Rate limits,
credential requirements, and structured errors match the league-wide refresh.

post.description:
Join the league named by a valid member invite, creating exactly one membership.

Unknown, expired, admin-role, and league-less invites share one structured 400 so the endpoint
does not reveal which part failed; a duplicate membership returns 409. The submitted code is
never echoed in the response or an error message.
